title: Agent Farming Accuracy & Workflow Release
status: Production deployed; Farm intelligence screening v3 active
summary: Major Agent workflow release focused on correctness before expansion: repaired Chapter 123 farm screening so nominal/token sales cannot create absurd ratios or false annual-impact rankings, added categorized NJ location discovery for farm mapping, made destructive live-list actions unmistakable, and rebuilt Report Studio refresh behavior so newly hydrated intelligence is carried into the printable report view.

items.detail: Assessment screening now rejects nominal/token recorded consideration and implausible assessment-to-sale ratios before Chapter 123 metrics are generated.
Decimal Chapter 123 ratios are rendered as percentages while percentage-point metrics remain percentage points.
NJ geocoder suggestions are categorized as ZIP Code, County, Town / Municipality or Address, with ZIP-oriented secondary context and grouped results.
A completed intelligence refresh now triggers a clean report rebuild so the print/PDF surface is reconstructed from the refreshed governed values rather than leaving a stale preview.
Delete now changes to an explicit red destructive hover/focus state without changing the normal neutral appearance.
farm-intelligence-scan v3 remains authenticated, quota-aware and plan-aware; the existing quota and entitlement backend was preserved.
Latest main deployment is READY in Vercel production and the v0.50 frontend assets are deployed from main.
